lighting: Completely flat and unlit. Every material is one single solid value with no shading of any kind — no highlights, no shadows, no gradients, no darkening inside joints or recesses, no soft edges. Surfaces are told apart only by the flat colour value of the material each one is made of.

phrase_provenance.clause: §6.4 arm C — 'Flat — material value only.' This is the STRICT reading of §6.3, included so the strict reading is tested rather than assumed to be what §6.3 meant.

phrase_provenance.phrase: no darkening inside joints or recesses
phrase_provenance.clause: This single phrase is what separates C from B, and it is the experiment. §6.4 argues that receive-light 'does not necessarily mean flat' and can retain self-occlusion; C is the arm that takes it to mean flat anyway. If B and C are indistinguishable, §6.4's central distinction was not a real one.

phrase_provenance.phrase: Surfaces are told apart only by the flat colour value of the material
phrase_provenance.clause: §12 — 'value separation from the surface beneath', threshold PLACEHOLDER. C is the arm where value separation is the ONLY readability mechanism in the asset: no ring (§12.1), no shading, no highlight. If §12's PLACEHOLDER threshold is ever derived, this arm is where it would have to hold.

shading.clause: The lever at the floor of the enum — the same axis arm A and arm B move along, taken to its end. This is the value whose live-ness the surface audit established on this endpoint (the column-2 pair was flat-vs-detailed under conditioning, pixdiff 1.0000 vs a 0.3542 noise floor), so C's parameter is the best-evidenced of the three. ⚠ Measurable is not correct-in-direction; the eye rules (§13.2, §13.4).

note: C is expected to look worst on a contact sheet and that expectation must not be allowed to do any work. §6.3 states the trap outright: 'receive-light assets look flat and slightly disappointing on a contact sheet. They come alive only in the lit scene. A critic — or a human at a gate — who rejects a receive-light asset for looking underlit in isolation is applying the wrong instrument in the wrong context.' STOP 1 curation is out-of-scene by necessity and is the exact place this trap bites hardest. It is flagged on this file rather than left to memory.
